Fields.Name: Property Bag
Fields.Description: Havok's attached properties (not used by the games).

Fields.Name: Variable Bindings
Fields.Description: The bindings that drive this object's fields from behavior variables or character properties each frame.

Fields.Name: User Data
Fields.Description: A value for the game's own use; Havok doesn't read it.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: The node's name. Used to find it in the outline and in the action scripts; it doesn't have to be unique.

Fields.Name: Enable
Fields.Description: Whether the modifier runs. A disabled modifier leaves the pose it's given unchanged.

Fields.Name: Axis Of Rotation
Fields.Description: The axis the bones twist around.

Fields.Name: Twist Angle
Fields.Description: How far the chain twists, in radians. Usually bound to a variable.

Fields.Name: Start Bone
Fields.Description: The first bone of the twisted chain.

Fields.Name: End Bone
Fields.Description: The last bone of the twisted chain.

Fields.Name: Set Angle Method
Fields.Description: How the twist is spread over the chain: evenly (linear) or growing towards the end (ramped).

Fields.Name: Rotation Axis Coordinates
Fields.Description: The space the axis is in: model, the parent bone's, or each bone's own.

Fields.Name: Is Additive
Fields.Description: Whether the twist is added to the pose's rotation, rather than replacing it.
